name: Bear Trapper Slow-Cooked Hot Roast Beef & Mashed Potatoes
brandOrRestaurant: Bear Trapper Steakhouse (Garden City / Bear Lake, UT)
searchKeywords: garden city roast beef mashed potatoes
whyItWorks: Slow-cooked roast beef is fork-tender with broken-down connective tissue, served over soft white bread and whipped mashed potatoes with zero roughage.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Hot Roast Beef Sandwich platter with mashed potatoes and ask for gravy on the side so you can control the richness.
watchOuts: Mashed potatoes and gravy contain dairy and roux—take lactase and ask for gravy on the side
